venue.details: The competition will be held at UBC, on the second floor of IBLC in room 261.

items.information: This competition has **only blindfolded** and **fewest moves** events. Spectators and competitors must **remain silent** whenever anyone is competing, to allow for concentration. While you only need to show up for events/rounds that you are competing in, we would appreciate competitors being present for other events/rounds too when not inconvenient, to **help with judging**. If you have a parent or friend who can come judge, that would be great - it's not hard, even if you know nothing about cubing. **Note about venue**: Unlike previous competitions held in UBC, this competition's venue is **not** at the Nest. The venue is located in IKB Learning Centre (see Venue Details), which is still quite close to the Nest.

items.name: SESI Rondônia Open 2020
items.information: **PORTUGUESE** A competição é reconhecida pela Associação Mundial de Cubo Mágico (WCA) e os resultados farão parte dos rankings oficiais. Teremos premiações (medalhas) para os três primeiros colocados de cada modalidade. Contamos com a colaboração de TODOS para tornar a competição mais fluida. Portanto, quando solicitado, prontifique-se para ser juiz, embaralhador ou runner. **ENGLISH** The competition is acknowledged by the World Cube Association (WCA) and the results will be ranked officially. There will be prizes (medals) for the first three best results in each event. We count on EVERYBODY's collaboration to make this competition more fluid. Therefore, when asked, please be ready to be a judge, scrambler or runner.

items.information: Pensez à consulter les onglets, en particulier celui du [planning](#competition-schedule). Merci également de **lire attentivement les conditions d'inscription**. Concernant les épreuves du vendredi après midi et notamment les finales du 6x6 et 7x7, l'équipe d'organisation souhaiterait que les personnes qualifiées pour la demi finale soient présentes pour assurer le bon déroulement de la dernière épreuve de la journée (juges, mélangeurs..). Une collation (snack, boissons) sera offerte en fin de journée pour les personnes ayant permis d´assurer la finale. ---- Make sure to read the information in the tabs, especially the one with the [schedule](#competition-schedule). Also, **please read the registration conditions carefully**. Concerning 6x6 and 7x7 Finals, the organisation team would be grateful if the people qualified for the semi final could help us to judge and scramble during the final rounds. The people who helped will receive a free snack and drink to thank them.
